_generated: Generated from src/python.yaml — do not edit by hand. Run: npx tsx generate.ts

notes.uv: Package manager + lockfile (uv.lock) — the real, already-adopted convention in newer data-pipeline services. Prefer over bare pip/requirements.txt or Poetry for new projects.
notes.ruff: Linter + formatter — replaces black, isort, flake8, pylint
notes.pydantic: Runtime data validation and settings management
notes.httpx: HTTP client with async support — replaces requests
notes.psycopg: PostgreSQL adapter (psycopg3) — pipeline services write to Postgres directly; prefer over psycopg2-binary for new code.
notes.pyarrow: Columnar data format — the real interchange format used by data-pipeline services
notes.pandas: Dataframe library used across data-pipeline services
notes.psycopg2-binary: Legacy PostgreSQL adapter — still present in some services; migrate to psycopg (psycopg3) where practical
notes.sqlalchemy: ORM and SQL toolkit — v2 required (v1 API removed); only for services that need an ORM, not a default
notes.fastapi: Modern async API framework — for the minority of services that expose an HTTP API
notes.flask: Lightweight WSGI framework — v3 required (v2 EOL)
notes.gunicorn: WSGI server for Flask — v22 has security fixes

prohibited_notes.black: Use ruff format instead — ruff is a strict superset of black
prohibited_notes.isort: Use ruff --select I instead — isort is redundant with ruff
prohibited_notes.flake8: Use ruff check instead — ruff covers all flake8 rules and more
prohibited_notes.pylint: Use ruff check + mypy — pylint is slow and redundant
prohibited_notes.requests: Use httpx — async-capable, modern interface, active development

agent_requirement.reason: Agents generating or modifying Python must run ruff check + mypy before declaring work complete — type errors and lint violations caught at write time, not review time
agent_requirement.how: ruff check --fix <file> && mypy <file> — fix all errors; suppress only with # noqa: <code> and a rationale comment
agent_requirement.ci_gate_note: This is a hard gate, not advisory — a CI step that runs mypy with continue-on-error: true (or equivalent non-blocking config) contradicts enforced:true above and must not be shipped. If mypy isn't ready to block merge yet, set enforced:false here instead of running it non-blocking; a soft-fail check that looks like a gate is worse than no check.

claude_code.scope_reason: see node.yaml's lsp.claude_code.scope_reason -- same ruling, same date, applies to both.
claude_code.no_ruff_lsp: There is no dedicated ruff LSP plugin in this marketplace as of 2026-07-25. Ruff stays enforced via CLI (ruff check/format) and the pre-push hook (agent_requirement above), not via live diagnostics. pyright-lsp covers type-checking diagnostics (hover, goToDefinition, documentSymbol); it does not lint or format.

complexity.note: Matches node.yaml's floor for consistency across languages. Unlike node.yaml's 15 (already proven against real repos), this number has not yet been validated against a real Python codebase in this org -- adopted as a sane cross-language default, not yet battle-tested here. Revisit if it proves too strict/loose in practice.
